entities.name: Vacar Slab
entities.description: Sacred execution site of the Old Way religion of Kenlefia in Jamuraa.

entities.name: Kenlefia
entities.description: Home of the Old Way religion.

entities.name: Abuser
entities.description: Man the Kenlefians escorted to execution, who gave his name as Markus.

entities.name: Ophelia
entities.description: Methos's sister who freed the Abuser and survived.

entities.name: Spirokai
entities.description: Akron Legionnaire who feels no pain and buried the Abuser.

entities.name: Teeth
entities.description: Water-bearer who became a zombie then a mummy.

entities.name: Cleatin
entities.description: Gray Ogre protector killed by a Duneclaw.

events.summary: Kenlefians set out for Vacar Slab to execute the Abuser and die one after another.
events.quote: Two were ambushed by Aerathi berserkers and killed

events.summary: In a sandstorm Ophelia frees the Abuser, but Spirokai catches them and buries him to the neck.
events.quote: Spirokai caught them, though, and buried the Abuser up to the neck.

events.summary: A zombified Teeth slashes Spirokai in the head and then wraps himself in bandages, becoming a mummy.
events.quote: a zombified Teeth showed up and slashed Spirokai in the head with his sword

events.summary: Ophelia leaves alone while Spirokai starts to claw his way out.
events.quote: Spirokai had survived both his head wound and being buried alive, and started to claw his way out

relations.quote: As he was about to do the same to Ophelia for betraying him
